scope: Subsequently motivated architecture sensitivity. REST primary; ABIDE secondary ASD replication, not MDD external validation. No original results replaced.

model.name: GCNII-derived signed graph-shift comparator
model.head: Linear(Dropout(mean_nodes(H2))); BCEWithLogitsLoss; sigmoid for prediction
model.initialization: Xavier uniform input and propagation weights; zero explicit biases; PyTorch Linear default head
model.adaptations: Signed spectral-normalized S replaces normalized adjacency; anatomical identity features; graph-level mean head; explicit biases. No canonical GCNII theorem claimed.

models.forward: H1=ReLU(S W0+b0); H2=ReLU(S H1 W1+b1); h=mean_nodes(H2); logit=h w+b
models.head: linear
models.loss: unweighted binary cross entropy with logits
models.seed_rule: same initialization/dropout stream for arms in a given fold/inner role; independent outer contexts; frozen hash seeds
models.inner_selection: equal validation-site macro Brier across all inner predictions
models.tie_rule: within 1e-10 prefer larger weight decay, then fewer epochs

selection: Three fixed grouped inner partitions; macro Brier; grid wd [0.01,0.0001], epochs [80,160]; tolerance1e-10 ties prefer larger wd then fewer epochs. lr0.01 Adam, clip5, all parameters decay. No target calibration.
seed_protocol: Exact integers in roles; primary seed reused from original; extra seeds1/2 temporal/budget only, primary-selected hyperparameters, no retuning. Same integer is not identical initialization across architectures.
primary: REST equal-cohort Gamma=(new temporal Brier-new budget Brier)-(original temporal Brier-original budget Brier), primary seed0
secondary: Both architecture contrasts; ABIDE Gamma; all-arm AUC/Brier/log loss/calibration; collapse; three seeds; finite-input replay; existing metadata/prior/LR controls

bootstrap.scheme: Paired within cohort x diagnosis; separate cohort-cluster with fresh within resample; all models share draws
bootstrap.limitations: Conditional on fixed predictions, excludes training/selection uncertainty. No equivalence or algorithm-level superiority. ABIDE5 centers; finite3.
bootstrap.calibration: 2000 pooled fixed-cohort diagnosis-stratified draws, failure counts; per-cohort slope suppressed unless >=50 per class; no recalibration

collapse.also_report: exact zero range, <=1e-6 REST historical sensitivity, SD, logits and embeddings, same hard class; never exclude

finite_inputs: REST native230/last190; ABIDE native230 means first230. first190 and last190 overlap150; preprocessing already full-run; all arms primary, extra seeds temporal/budget; no refit.
confounding: Reuse original metadata predictions, cohort handling and metadata sources. ABIDE low FD<=0.2 fixed-score sensitivity; within-cohort age/FD/sex association; REST raw QC categories and whole-derivative FD, no invented temporal alignment.

limits.stop: One architecture only. Stop on unresolved provenance/leakage/nonfinite error; repair only demonstrated implementation errors with disclosure. No grid/depth/width/readout/seed/cohort expansion; report all results; stop implementation after verification.
